title: Walmart (WMT) Exceeds Market Returns: Some Facts to Consider
author: Na
description: Walmart closed at $107.20, up 2.03% in the latest session, outperforming the S&P 500's 0.58% gain. However, the stock has declined 1.93% over the past month. The company is expected to report Q3 EPS of $0.63 (up 1.61% YoY) and quarterly revenue of $186.47 billion (up 3.88% YoY). Despite positive earnings growth expectations, Walmart carries a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 36.56, significantly above the industry average of 13.13, and a PEG ratio of 4.01 versus the industry average of 1.77.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Walmart shows positive near-term price momentum (+2.03%) and solid earnings growth expectations (EPS +1.61% YoY, revenue +3.88% YoY), the stock carries a Hold rating (Zacks Rank #3). The valuation appears stretched with a Forward P/E of 36.56 versus industry average of 13.13 and a PEG ratio of 4.01 versus industry average of 1.77, suggesting limited upside at current prices despite fundamentals.

title: Costco's Digital Sales Top $33 Billion: Can E-commerce Keep Scaling?
author: Na
description: Costco's digital business exceeded $33 billion in fiscal 2026 with over 20% growth, driven by same-day delivery partnerships, personalized product placements, and AI-powered search. The company's e-commerce comparable sales rose 19.5% in Q4, while competitors Walmart and Target also posted strong digital momentum with 23-24% and 8.7% growth respectively.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Costco demonstrated strong digital momentum with $33B+ in digitally enabled sales growing over 20%, Q4 comparable sales up 19.5%, and triple-digit growth in personalized placements and AI search traffic. The company is successfully scaling e-commerce while maintaining incremental sales rather than cannibalizing warehouse traffic.

Walmart reported robust e-commerce growth of 23% globally and 24% in the U.S., with store-fulfilled deliveries up 40% and fast delivery up 48%, demonstrating effective digital scaling and fulfillment capabilities.

Target posted healthy digital growth with comparable digital sales up 8.7%, led by same-day delivery growth exceeding 25%, and AI-powered traffic rising 3.5x the industry rate, indicating strong digital engagement and technology adoption.

title: Can Walmart Connect Keep Powering WMT's Digital Profit Growth?
author: Na
description: Walmart's digital business is becoming a major contributor to its overall economics, with global advertising revenue up 38% and Walmart Connect growing 43% in Q2 fiscal 2027. U.S. e-commerce sales rose 24%, achieving double-digit incremental margins supported by advertising, membership revenues, and improved delivery capabilities. The company also expanded ad capabilities through the acquisition of Vibe.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong double-digit growth across advertising (38%), Walmart Connect (43%), and e-commerce (24%). Achieved double-digit incremental margins in U.S. e-commerce and improved gross profit mix. Strategic acquisition of Vibe expands advertising capabilities.

title: BP highlighted as Zacks Bull and MasterCraft Boat Bear of the Day
author: Zacks Equity Research
description: Zacks Equity Research designated BP p.l.c. as the Bull of the Day due to new CEO leadership, debt reduction strategy, and five consecutive earnings beats with analyst estimates raised to $7.28 for 2026. MasterCraft Boat Holdings was named Bear of the Day as analysts cut fiscal 2027 earnings estimates despite consistent quarterly beats, with guidance falling short of consensus expectations during its fiscal-to-calendar year transition.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: New CEO with debt reduction strategy, five consecutive earnings beats, analyst estimate raises to $7.28 for 2026 (152.8% earnings growth), attractive valuation metrics (P/E of 6.2, P/S of 0.5), 4.6% dividend yield, and benefits from sustained high oil prices around $90-$100.

Analysts cut fiscal 2027 earnings estimates from $2.02 to $1.86, company guidance of $0.66-$0.76 for transition period falls significantly below consensus of $0.85, shares down 17.4% in three months, and confusion around earnings during fiscal-to-calendar year transition despite historical earnings beat streak.

Shares rallied 23.7% over three months versus industry decline of 2.4%, forward P/E of 15.99 below industry average of 27.16, consensus estimates signal 37.8% earnings growth for current fiscal year, $5 billion capex plan supporting store expansion and technology modernization, Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

Raised fiscal 2027 capex outlook to 4% of net sales from 3.5%, investing in automation, technology, and fulfillment capacity to improve inventory flow and omnichannel operations, demonstrating confidence in growth strategy.

Fiscal 2026 capex of $1.4-$1.5 billion directed toward store growth, remodels, supply-chain projects and technology, with approximately 4,730 real-estate projects planned, demonstrating commitment to expansion and modernization.

title: Costco Is Down 10% in 6 Months While the S&P 500 Is Up 17%. Is Costco Too Cheap to Pass Up Under $900 a Share?
author: John Bromels
description: Costco's stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 27 percentage points over the last six months, despite growing revenue, profits, and membership renewal rates. While the company maintains a premium valuation compared to retail peers due to strong membership loyalty, the article argues that at current prices, Costco is not as cheap as it appears. Headwinds from tariffs and fuel costs, combined with elevated valuations, suggest investors seeking faster growth may find better opportunities elsewhere.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Costco demonstrates strong fundamentals with growing revenue, profits, and high membership renewal rates (92.3%), the article concludes the stock is not a bargain at current prices. The company trades at a significant premium to peers and faces headwinds from tariffs and fuel costs. Suitable only for long-term buy-and-hold investors, not for those seeking faster growth.
